description: Defines the HpackDecoder class for decoding HPACK blocks in HTTP/2, including methods for setting string size limits, applying header table size settings, starting, decoding, and ending HPACK blocks, and error handling.

classes.name: HpackDecoder
classes.description: Main class responsible for decoding HPACK blocks, managing decoder state, and notifying listeners.

methods.name: set_max_string_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of strings accepted during decoding to prevent OOM attacks.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Updates the header table size based on SETTINGS ACK frames.

methods.name: GetCurrentHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Returns the current header table size setting.

methods.name: StartDecodingBlock
methods.description: Prepares the decoder to start decoding a new HPACK block.

methods.name: DecodeFragment
methods.description: Decodes a fragment of an HPACK block and reports header entries.

methods.name: EndDecodingBlock
methods.description: Finalizes decoding of an HPACK block and reports completion.

methods.name: DetectError
methods.description: Checks for errors in the decoding process.
